app_fee.value: No application fee is named on the doctoral admission pages checked.

fee_waiver.value: No application-fee waiver is described on the doctoral admission pages checked.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement appears on the doctoral admission pages checked.

toefl_min.value: Doctoral applicants generally need no English certificate, so no TOEFL score is asked for. The TOEFL 87 minimum applies only to the master's route.
toefl_min.quote: For applications for admission to a doctoral programme proof of language proficiency is generally not necessary.

ielts_min.value: Doctoral applicants generally need no English certificate, so no IELTS band is asked for. The IELTS 6.5 minimum applies only to the master's route.
ielts_min.quote: For applications for admission to a doctoral programme proof of language proficiency is generally not necessary.

english_waiver.value: Doctoral applicants generally need no English certificate, so an English-medium degree from India needs no waiver. The India exclusion on the master's English-medium list does not apply to doctoral applications.
english_waiver.quote: For applications for admission to a doctoral programme proof of language proficiency is generally not necessary.

notes: TU Wien runs three umbrella doctoral programmes: Engineering Sciences (796 700), Natural Sciences (796 600) and Social and Economic Sciences (796 300). Doctoral admission periods on the academic calendar cover winter 2026/27 (6 July to 10 December 2026) and summer 2027 (7 January to 10 June 2027); no winter 2027/28 window is published yet. Non-EU doctoral students pay tuition from the first semester; this is not an application fee.
